_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Yu pleia {player_id} long gem bilong LinesOfAction.
Pisi bilong yu '{side}', pisi bilong birua '{other}'.
Fomat bilong muv: `[b1b3]` (koardinat as i go long koardinat kamap). Wanpela muv i ken i go stret, i go daon, o i go kona, na i go long namba bilong pisi (kala wanem) long lain. Yu ken kalapim pisi bilong yu yet, tasol no ken kalapim pisi bilong birua; taim yu kamap long pisi bilong birua, yu kisim.  Yu win taim ol pisi bilong yu i konnek long olgeta.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dispela fomet i mas e2e4 (long,go long ol koordinit).
invalid_move.identical: As bilong ol samting na ples ol i go long en, tupela wantaim.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Em i mas wokabaut stret o long sait bilong mak.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Em i mas wokabaut long mak wankain olsem ol hap bilong lain.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ples we yu laik go i gat wanpela bilong yu yet.

outcome.draw_no_capture: 60 man i go na ol i no holim em.
outcome.draw_repetition: Ol i mekim olsem tripela taim.
